overview.timeline: Vulnerabilities added to KEV per month
overview.timeline_help: The date is when CISA listed the vulnerability, often later than the first real exploitation.
overview.vendors_help: A large footprint means more entries. This is not a ranking of how safe a vendor is.
overview.kev_epss: How EPSS scores today what is already known to be exploited
overview.kev_epss_help: Descriptive only. EPSS already knows these cases, so this does not measure its predictive skill.
pipeline.schedule: Automatic runs at {times} UTC. Next run: {next}.
pipeline.started: Started {source}. Refresh in a few seconds.
pipeline.backfill_help: Downloads the days that are missing in the range, one file per day (about 2 MB each).
epss.lookup_empty: No stored score for this CVE.
epss.lookup_one: Only one day stored so far: the history grows with each daily snapshot.
news.help: Type of event, firmness and sectors come from keyword rules: they are simple labels and some are wrong. The same story from several feeds is grouped when the titles are close; Italian and English versions are not grouped yet. Published is the publisher's time; First seen is when this system collected the item, the only time used for modelling.
news.feeds_summary: {ok} of {n} active feeds answered at the last collection.
col.title: Title
news.trend_help: Counted by publication day (UTC). This measures press and advisory coverage seen by these feeds, not the number of attacks. A sector is counted when it is mentioned, whether or not it was the target.
vulns.no_data: No vulnerability catalogue yet. Open Pipeline and run NVD.
vulns.as_of: NVD records as last retrieved on {date}
vulns.by_year_help: The current year is still filling up. Counts include every CVE NVD holds, exploited or not.
vulns.vendors_help: A wide product range means more records. This is not a measure of how secure a vendor is.
vulns.lookup_empty: Nothing stored about this CVE yet.
vulns.kev_added: Added to KEV on {date}. Known ransomware use: {ransomware}.
vulns.exploits: Public exploit code for this CVE
vulns.nvd_missing: The CVE catalogue has not been downloaded yet. Open Pipeline and run NVD: the first download takes 15-20 minutes without an API key.
